manufacturer.name: Novation
manufacturer.note: 3-byte extended manufacturer ID 00 20 29 observed at offset 1..3 of the byte-exact fixture below; 00 20 29 is Novation Digital Music Systems' registered MIDI manufacturer ID.

model.name: Summit
model.note: Confirmed by the Product Owner as the source device of the fixture below; not derived from SysEx byte content alone.

manufacturer_id.note: Offset 1..3 of the captured single-patch dump (F0 00 20 29 ...).

family_id.note: Byte at offset 4 of the captured dump. Only ever observed as this one value in one capture; whether it is a family ID, a product ID, or something else is not established without Novation's official SysEx implementation chart.

model_id.note: Bytes at offset 5..6 of the captured dump. Semantic meaning not established; recorded structurally only.

device_id_behavior.note: Only one static single-patch capture exists, with one fixed byte pattern throughout. Whether any of these bytes is a configurable MIDI Device ID (as opposed to a fixed product identifier) cannot be determined from a single capture; needs official documentation or a second capture taken with the Summit's Device ID changed.

dump_types.note: One complete F0..F7 frame; F0 at offset 0, F7 at offset 526. Matches the Stage 4 recognition fingerprint 'summit-single-patch-header' already declared in resources/device_profiles/novation-summit.profile.json. Observed on exactly one fixture; not yet confirmed as fixed-size across firmware revisions or patch content.

bank_organization.note: Not established. The only available fixture is a single-patch dump, not a bank dump, so bank/slot addressing has not been observed.

checksum.note: Explicitly out of scope for the Stage 4 recognition work this entry is built on: tests/fixtures/novation_summit_crazy_sine.provenance.json records 'No checksum implementation' as a restriction on that fixture. No checksum algorithm has been derived or verified.

fixtures.note: Reused from the existing, already byte-verified Stage 4 test fixture rather than duplicated here; that fixture is user-provided, private, and marked redistribution forbidden (see its provenance file and docs/reference/PROVENANCE.md).

status_summary: Manufacturer ID and single-patch dump framing are confirmed byte-exact from one user-provided fixture. Family/model ID bytes are recorded structurally but not semantically interpreted. Device ID behavior, bank/slot organization, and checksum method are unknown. No official Novation documentation has been catalogued yet.
notes: First reference-archive entry (v1 proof of concept). Deliberately thin: it exists to prove the reference/schema/device.json/fixture data path, not to be a complete Summit specification. Extend it only as further evidence (official documentation, additional captures) becomes available; do not upgrade any 'observed' or 'unknown' status to 'confirmed' without new evidence.
